scope: Behavior, ARIA and form participation of the web component in happy-dom (node:test). Rendered lengths are covered by the browser geometry check; visual quality and screen-reader output are not certified.

checks.covers: keys, Page Up 10%, Home/End, pointer mapping, ratio variable, determinate and indeterminate progress
the data-* state contract (contracts/states.json): the same state attributes on the web component (happy-dom) and the React renderer (SSR) for the same state; field state after blur, typing and focus

Base UI event details on both renderers: change / input / openchange detail { value | checked | pressed | open, reason, event } and React (value, { reason, event }) with the same reasons; value / defaultValue, checked / defaultChecked; select open / defaultOpen

composition: authored [data-part] parts render the same parts, recipe classes, data-* and hidden flags as the generated anatomy; authored attributes, classes and content are adopted, text seeds properties, a reconnect keeps them
native input/progress inside a data-ui host, construction-pattern parts, form names and values, no custom elements
